content: Transactional outbox converts the dual-write problem (update DB + publish event) into a single write: events are inserted into an outbox table in the same transaction as the state change, and a separate relay publishes them. Guarantees at-least-once delivery, survives crashes, requires idempotent consumers. CDC (Debezium) is the heavyweight relay; a polling relay is fine at small scale. Directly applicable to side effects like posting PR comments and opening PRs from a state transition.
